state_constraints: The initial states (desktop, mobile, tablet) capture the AdminKit analytics dashboard scrolled to top with the sidebar, navbar and KPI cards; the Report queue panel must render above the KPI cards on the dashboard.

desktop_queue and mobile_queue scroll to #queue-filter so the Report queue panel is captured in place; desktop_queue_resolved additionally clicks the Resolved chip; desktop_cards and desktop_forms scroll to the same #queue-filter panel on ui-cards.html and ui-forms.html.
design_goal: complete or refine a user workflow across one or more meaningful screens
problem_statement: adminkit/adminkit is a self-contained static Bootstrap 5 admin dashboard served as prebuilt HTML (index.html analytics dashboard plus ui-cards.html, ui-forms.html, ui-tables.html, ui-buttons.html, charts-chartjs.html, pages-blank.html and pages-profile.html) with a shared collapsible sidebar and top navbar; there is no build step and the CSS (css/app.css) and JS (js/app.js) are bundled locally. Deliver a coordinated 'Report queue' triage control on the dashboard while preserving the shell, the sidebar nav, the KPI cards, the charts and the responsive behavior: (1) Add a 'Report queue' panel to the dashboard (index.html) with a status filter row (All / Open / In review / Resolved chips) above a grid of eight report rows, each tagged with a status badge, plus a live '#queue-readout' count. REPAIR the responsive layout so the chip row stays within the viewport on a 390px phone with no horizontal overflow — do not merely clip it; the document itself must not exceed the mobile viewport width. (2) Surface the SAME shared 'Report queue' panel CONSISTENTLY on the dashboard AND on the ui-cards.html AND ui-forms.html pages, styled to match the AdminKit light card palette (white surface, blue accent chips, rounded rows) — the rendered panel must be visually faithful to the reference, not a collapsed, overlapping, or illegible slab. (3) Wire the status filter end to end: clicking a status chip (e.g. Resolved) must filter the report rows AND update the '#queue-readout' readout to 'Showing N of 8 reports · <status>' (clicking Resolved yields 'Showing 3 of 8 reports · Resolved') in addition to marking the active chip — the post-click terminal state must reflect the selected status, not the default 'Showing 8 of 8 reports · All'. Keep the KPI cards, the analytics charts, the sidebar/navbar, the secondary pages and the desktop/tablet layouts intact, and keep the site static with a clean browser console (no remote CDN/font requests).
required_content: A 'Report queue' panel is added to the dashboard (index.html) with a status chip row (All / Open / In review / Resolved) above a grid of eight report rows with status badges and a live count readout, rendering within the viewport on a 390px phone with no horizontal document overflow beyond 24px.
The SAME shared 'Report queue' panel appears CONSISTENTLY on the dashboard AND on the ui-cards.html AND ui-forms.html pages — the same component in all three places, not only on the dashboard.

The 'Report queue' panel keeps the AdminKit light card palette (white surface, blue accent chips, rounded rows) and is visually faithful to the reference rendering — not a collapsed, overlapping, or illegible restyle.

The status filter is wired end to end: clicking a status chip filters the report rows and updates the '#queue-readout' readout to 'Showing N of 8 reports · <status>' (e.g. clicking Resolved sets 'Showing 3 of 8 reports · Resolved') in addition to marking the chip active; the post-click terminal state reflects the selected status, not the default.

The ui-cards.html and ui-forms.html secondary pages share the sidebar navigation and stay reachable (real routes, not 404), and the desktop (1440px) and tablet (834px) layouts stay within their viewports.
The KPI cards, the analytics charts, the sidebar and navbar remain reachable and unchanged, and the static site keeps a clean browser console (no remote CDN/font errors).
design_constraints: Fix the responsive layout of the Report queue chip row; do not delete the panel, change its eight report rows, or restyle unrelated dashboard sections.
Add the SAME shared 'Report queue' panel to the dashboard, the ui-cards.html page AND the ui-forms.html page so the triage control is consistent across the admin; do not add it to only one page.
Preserve the AdminKit design language: the sidebar, navbar, KPI/chart cards, blue accent, rounded cards; the panel must render in the light card palette and stay legible.
Keep the status filter interaction wired end to end (the #queue-readout terminal readout must reflect the clicked status and the rows must filter), not merely a class toggle.

Do not introduce external stylesheets, remote fonts, CDNs, or new remote script/asset dependencies; the site must stay a self-contained static build with a clean console, and the secondary pages must share the same sidebar and stay real routes.

change_completion: The Report queue chip row renders within the viewport on mobile with no overflow.
The shared Report queue panel appears on the dashboard, the ui-cards.html page AND the ui-forms.html page.
The status filter click filters the rows and updates the #queue-readout terminal readout to the selected status.
design_consistency: The AdminKit palette, sidebar, navbar, KPI/chart rhythm, and accent color are preserved.
The Report queue panel keeps the light card look and is visually faithful to the reference across the dashboard + secondary pages.
responsive: 390px dashboard (initial, queue) has no horizontal overflow beyond 24px; 834px tablet is clean.
The status chips wrap or shrink cleanly instead of forcing a fixed-width row.
regression: The KPI cards, analytics charts, sidebar, navbar and footer remain reachable and unchanged.
The static site serves from index.html + ui-cards.html + ui-forms.html with a clean console.

author_notes: Repo-grounded static multi-page dashboard_admin task on adminkit/adminkit (a Bootstrap 5 admin dashboard image/screenshot template with a sidebar, KPI cards and analytics charts) hardened to L4. The reference (a) adds a native 'Report queue' status-filter panel to the dashboard whose chip row WRAPS fluidly on mobile (flex 1 1 auto, min-width:0 -> 0 overflow), (b) surfaces the same shared panel on the dashboard AND ui-cards.html AND ui-forms.html in the AdminKit light card palette, and (c) wires the status filter so clicking Resolved filters the eight report rows and updates #queue-readout to 'Showing 3 of 8 reports · Resolved'. The baseline is the original responsive defect: a fixed 720px nowrap chip row that overflows the phone viewport ~564px and renders the panel on the dashboard ONLY (D2 cross-page fails on cards + forms; D6 mobile overflow fails; the mobile queue crop reflows so D3 fails on the mobile state), but its filter JS is CORRECT so the baseline PASSES D4 -> leg-orthogonal. The bad 'smart-wrong' solution collapses the whole panel on the DEFAULT desktop state — chip row nowrap min-width:180px overflow, report rows shingled via negative margins into an overlapping illegible pile, and near-white chips/readout on a near-white bar (contrast failure) -> D3 visual_regression fails on all three metrics (block_fidelity + pixelmatch + ssim); it also keeps the fixed 720px bar so mobile overflows ~584px (D6 fail), renders the panel on the dashboard + cards only (D2 fails on forms), and toggles the chip .is-active class while the #queue-readout stays a frozen 'Showing 8 of 8 reports · All' const with no row filtering (click succeeds but terminal state stale -> D4 interaction_assertions fail). bad fails FOUR distinct gates while all text/completion/regression/console signals pass. The Google Fonts (Inter) remote link is dropped and AdminKit's html{overflow-x:hidden}/.main{overflow:hidden} shell clips are neutralized, all declared INFRA and identical across the three legs so horizontal overflow is genuinely measurable.
